logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows.

scenes.heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle macro shot tracking through an impenetrable, menacing thicket of frozen blackthorn briars encrusted with frost.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Whistling winter wind and an ominous low brass drone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Pleading, Agonized)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Unwavering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I must.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Terrified for Her)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: They will tear your hands apart.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I will be fine.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Fierce)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

segments.label: JULIANA (Emotional, Devoted)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

segments.label: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Mocking, Vindictive)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: Careful, sister.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

segments.label: CLARISSA (Cruel, Sarcastic)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: That garden has swallowed better women than you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.

segments.label: GERALD (Condescending, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Screaming, Panicked)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana, stop!

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Rattling of heavy iron chains.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Please...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gasping in Pain)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.

segments.label: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: Look at her hands.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

segments.label: CLARISSA (Mocking, Spiteful)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

segments.label: GERALD (Taunting, Cruel)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Choked)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Please... enough!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming in Pain)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Ah!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Booming)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Stop!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.

segments.label: JULIANA (Agonized Scream)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Ahhh!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring in Torment)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate Shout)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

segments.label: JULIANA (Panting, Praying)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.
